title: Recovering a set from its tail frequencies
statement: Let $T$ be a subset of $\\{0,1,\\ldots,n\\}$ that does not contain $0$. Delete the initial coordinate from the indices in $T$ to obtain a subset of $\\{0,1,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, then shift those indices up by one; the resulting set is exactly $T$.
